blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Radiological risk stratification and management planning are essential downstream tasks in medical imaging. Automating these tasks is challenging because clinical guideline criteria are distributed across prose, tables, and cross-referenced definitions. We present Guideline-derived Decision Graph (GDGraph), a framework that decouples guideline compilation from case evaluation. During compilation, a large language model partitions guidelines into section-based chunks, extracts local decision subgraphs with linked definitions, and aggregates related branches into an executable decision graph. During inference, a fast System One model answers localized clinical questions while deterministic traversal resolves Boolean logic, turning opaque single-pass predictions into a traceable decision path without task-specific training. Across 347 cases spanning renal cyst, adnexal mass, and thyroid nodule guidelines, GDGraph improves System One accuracy from 57.3% to 90.8%, outperforming retrieval-augmented GPT-4o (80.1%) and graph-guided GPT-4o with chain-of-thought (82.7%) at substantially lower latency and cost. The source code will be available.
blocks.zh: 辐射风险分层和管理规划是医疗成像中的重要下游任务。 自动化这些任务具有挑战性,因为临床准则标准分布在道词,表和交叉引用的定义之间. 我们提出由准则产生的决定图(GDGraph),这个框架将准则汇编与案例评价脱钩。 在编译过程中,一款大型语言模型将分出准则分入以节为主的块中,取出带有链接定义的本地决定子图,将相干分支汇总成可执行的决定图. 在推论期间,快取系统一号模型解答了局部的临床问题,而决定性的转录解析了布尔逻辑,将不透明的单行道预测转变为可追踪的决定路径而无需接受特定任务的培训. 在涵盖肾囊肿、肾上腺质和甲状腺结核准则的347个病例中,GDGraph改进了System 1的精度从57.3%到90.8%,优于回收增生的GPT-4o(80.1%)和以图示指导的GPT-4o,其延迟和成本低得多。 源代码将可用.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Risk stratification and management planning are essential downstream tasks in medical imaging that connect radiological findings to clinical care [ 2 ] . Clinical guidelines standardize these decisions across tasks such as renal cyst management [ 11 ] , adnexal mass assessment [ 15 ] , and thyroid nodule stratification [ 4 ] , where final recommendations follow from explicit, discrete decision criteria. Automating these tasks therefore requires systematically following the interdependent decision steps specified in each guideline, progressing from case-specific findings through successive criteria to a final category or recommendation.
blocks.zh: 风险分层和管理规划是医疗成像中将放射性结果与临床治疗联系起来的基本下游任务[2]. 临床准则使这些决定标准化,涵盖肾脏囊肿管理[11]、肾上腺质评估[15]和甲状腺结核分层[4]等任务,最后建议是根据明确、独立的决定标准提出的。 因此,实现这些任务的自动化需要系统地遵循每项准则中规定的相互依存的决定步骤,从个案调查结果通过连续的标准发展到最后类别或建议。

blocks.en: Pretrained language models can process free-text clinical reports and imaging findings directly through prompting without task-specific training [ 16 , 6 ] , yet have been shown to frequently deviate from established diagnostic guidelines [ 5 ] . Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting helps these models with multi-step clinical problems by eliciting reasoning steps in text before a conclusion [ 17 ] . In guideline-based risk stratification and management, clinical criteria and conditional rules also provide a structured basis for decomposing the overall task into a series of localized decisions, such as verifying a specific imaging feature or comparing a measurement against a threshold. System One models such as Jev [ 1 ] offer a suitable interface for these localized decisions by directly scoring discrete candidate options without generating intermediate text . Thus, the primary challenge is to organize these local judgments into an explicit decision process that preserves the guideline’s conditional dependencies and yields a traceable outcome for high-stakes decisions [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 事先经过培训的语言模型可以直接通过不进行特定任务培训的提示来处理自由文本临床报告和成像结果[16,6],然而已经证明经常偏离既定的诊断准则[5]. 启发思维链(CET)通过在结论[17]前在文本中引出推理步骤,帮助这些模型解决多步骤的临床问题. 在基于准则的风险分层和管理中,临床标准和有条件的规则也为将总体任务分解成一系列局部决定提供了结构化的基础,如核查特定的成像特征或将测量与阈值进行比较. 系统 Jev[1]等一种模型为这些本地化决定提供了一个合适的界面,直接评分离散的候选选项而不产生中间文本。 因此,主要的挑战是如何将这些地方判决组织成一个明确的决定程序,以维护准则的有条件依赖性,并产生对重大决定的可追踪结果[12]。

blocks.en: Existing clinical frameworks incorporate guideline knowledge in different ways. For a given patient case, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems [ 8 ] such as accGPT [ 10 ] retrieve relevant medical passages for the language model to interpret during response generation. CPGPrompt [ 3 ] converts segmented guideline text into decision trees for stepwise evaluation, with its reported workflow relying on manual selection of relevant text sections and manual validation of the generated trees. Such decision structures could harness the capabilities and efficiency of System One language models to support practical applications in clinical decision-making. However, automatic construction of these structures from raw guideline documents remains challenging because it requires integrating tabulated criteria and thresholds with terminology definitions and exception rules distributed across the document.
blocks.zh: 现有的临床框架以不同的方式纳入了指导知识。 对于给定的病人病例,检索-增强生成(RAG)系统[8]如accGPT[10]检索相关医疗通道,供语言模型在生成反应时解释. CPGPrompt [3] 将分块准则文本转换为决策树,以进行逐步评价,报告的工作流程依靠人工选择相关文本部分和人工验证生成的树。 这种决策结构可以利用系统一语言模型的能力和效率来支持临床决策的实际应用。 然而,从原始准则文件中自动构建这些结构仍然具有挑战性,因为它需要将列表标准和门槛与整个文件的术语定义和例外规则结合起来。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the GDGraph framework. (a) LLM-based Graph Construction: Offline, an LLM partitions clinical guidelines into m m section-based chunks { C i } i = 1 m \{C_{i}\}_{i=1}^{m} , extracts local subgraphs { G i } i = 1 m \{G_{i}\}_{i=1}^{m} with TF-IDF-retrieved definitions from a global memory, and aggregates related branches into a unified decision graph G G . (b) Graph-Guided Selection: Online, a System One model answers localized questions using case findings and attached definitions, guiding traversal along the selected path to reach a traceable decision.

blocks.en: To address this, we present Guideline-derived Decision Graph (GDGraph), an automated framework that compiles raw clinical guidelines into executable decision graphs for fast, traceable System One inference (Fig. 1 ). By decoupling offline LLM-based guideline structuring from online deterministic traversal, GDGraph reduces multi-step classification to localized node-level judgments while recording an explicit decision trace. Across 347 radiology cases spanning three guidelines, GDGraph raises System One accuracy from 57.3% to 90.8%, outperforming unstructured RAG (80.1%) and graph-guided GPT-4o with CoT (82.7%) at substantially lower latency and cost. These results suggest the practical value of GDGraph for clinical decision support.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们介绍了《准则》衍生的决定图表(GDGraph),这是一个自动框架,将原始临床准则汇编成可执行的决定图表,用于快速、可追踪的系统一推论(图1)。 GDGraph通过将基于LLM的离线准则结构从在线定点轨道中脱钩,将多步骤分类降低为局部节点级判断,同时记录了明确的裁判跟踪. 在347个放射病例中,GDGraph将系统一的精度从57.3%提高到90.8%,超过无结构的RAG(80.1%),以及用图形制导的GPT-4o与COT(82.7%),其延迟性和成本大大降低。 这些结果表明GDGraph对临床决策支持的实际价值.

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 2.1 概览

blocks.en: Fig. 1 illustrates the proposed Guideline-derived Decision Graph (GDGraph) framework, which decouples offline guideline compilation from online case evaluation. In the offline stage (Fig. 1 (a); Algorithm 1 ), given a clinical practice guideline D D containing narrative text, figures, and tables, an LLM-based pipeline partitions D D into m m section-based chunks { C i } i = 1 m \{C_{i}\}_{i=1}^{m} , extracts local subgraphs { G i } i = 1 m \{G_{i}\}_{i=1}^{m} grounded in a global definition memory M M via Term Frequency–Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) retrieval [ 14 , 13 ] , and aggregates related branches across sections into a unified decision graph G = ( 𝒮 , 𝒜 , ℰ , 𝒴 ) G=(\mathcal{S},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{Y}) . In the online stage (Fig. 1 (b)), given the imaging findings of a clinical case X X , a fast System One model answers localized questions at active nodes using attached definitions, while deterministic traversal resolves Boolean transitions along the selected path to reach a traceable category or management decision.

blocks.en: 2.2 Guideline-derived Decision Graph
blocks.zh: 2.2 源自准则的决定图

blocks.en: Graph Representation. The decision graph G = ( 𝒮 , 𝒜 , ℰ , 𝒴 ) G=(\mathcal{S},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{Y}) comprises clinical states 𝒮 \mathcal{S} (clinical contexts or intermediate conclusions, with entry states 𝒮 0 ⊂ 𝒮 \mathcal{S}_{0}\subset\mathcal{S} ), atomic conditions 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , directed transition rules ℰ \mathcal{E} , and candidate outcomes 𝒴 \mathcal{Y} (diagnostic categories or management actions). Each state and outcome carries a clinical label, a source-derived definition, and supporting text spans from D D . Each atomic condition a ∈ 𝒜 a\in\mathcal{A} represents a single traceable criterion, written as a = ( τ a , κ a , 𝒟 a ) a=(\tau_{a},\kappa_{a},\mathcal{D}_{a}) , where τ a \tau_{a} specifies the clinical feature and its anatomical or temporal scope (e.g., lesion diameter), κ a \kappa_{a} denotes the comparison operator and value (e.g., < 10 ​ cm <10\,\mathrm{cm} or presence/absence), and 𝒟 a \mathcal{D}_{a} links to the corresponding definitions in M M . Deterministic templates render each a a and its referenced definitions 𝒟 a \mathcal{D}_{a} into a self-contained question for model evaluation.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 GDGraph Construction
blocks.zh: 算法 1 GDGraph 构造

blocks.en: Section-Based Chunking and Local Subgraph Generation. We split D D by document sections into chunks C = { C 1 , … , C m } C=\{C_{1},\dots,C_{m}\} while keeping tables and footnotes intact. An LLM scans all chunks to build a global definition memory M M of clinical terms, aliases, and definitions. For each chunk C i C_{i} , we retrieve relevant definitions d i ⊂ M d_{i}\subset M via TF-IDF similarity while keeping explicitly cited definitions, and prompt the LLM to extract states 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} , atomic conditions 𝒜 i \mathcal{A}_{i} , and rules ℰ i \mathcal{E}_{i} into a local subgraph G i G_{i} . Named imaging patterns are kept as single conditions linked to M M , additional criteria such as numerical thresholds are separated into individual conditions, and negative findings are denoted by logical negation ( ¬ \neg ).

blocks.en: Cross-Branch Aggregation. To connect related rules across sections, local subgraphs { G i } i = 1 m \{G_{i}\}_{i=1}^{m} are merged into a unified graph G G . Guided by TF-IDF similarity, an LLM groups subgraphs sharing clinical features or exceptions into potentially overlapping sets ℬ = { B 1 , … , B L } \mathcal{B}=\{B_{1},\dots,B_{L}\} , processed sequentially on the latest graph. Within each group B l B_{l} , the LLM uses the source text and definitions d l d_{l} to merge nodes that share identical clinical meaning and judgment criteria, while keeping non-equivalent thresholds separate. When the guideline specifies upgrading or exception clauses, the LLM is instructed to update the conditions ( ϕ e \phi_{e} ) and targets ( T e T_{e} ) of affected rules e e , while keeping other valid standalone paths unchanged.

blocks.en: 2.3 Graph-Guided Selection
blocks.zh: 2.3 图导选择

blocks.en: Prior to evaluation, an LLM maps source-supported conclusions in 𝒮 ∪ 𝒴 \mathcal{S}\cup\mathcal{Y} , including intermediate states and terminal outcomes, to the target task’s standardized answer options, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (b). During online inference, traversal starts at 𝒮 0 \mathcal{S}_{0} . At each active state, the System One model answers the questions of outgoing atomic conditions based on the reported imaging findings and attached definitions 𝒟 a \mathcal{D}_{a} , while program logic evaluates ϕ e \phi_{e} to advance along satisfied branches. The final prediction is derived from the task-relevant conclusions reached during traversal, with the clinical case interpreted against static option definitions. The traversal log records each evaluated question and its answer, preserving the traversed edges as a traceable decision path.
blocks.zh: 在评价前,一个LLM将S QQ Y\mathcal{S}\cup\mathcal{Y}中源支持的结论,包括中间状态和终端结果,映射到目标任务的标准化答案选项,如图1(b)所示. 在网络推论中, traversal 开始于 S 0\ mathcal{S}_{0}. 在每一个活动状态下,一个系统模型根据所报道的成像结果和所附定义D a\mathcal{D}_{a}解答出原子条件的问题,而程序逻辑则评价\ e\phi_{e} 沿着满意的分支前进. 最终预测来源于在转弯期间得出的与任务相关的结论,临床病例根据静态选项定义进行解释. 反向日志记录了每个被评价的问答,保留了反向边缘作为可追踪的决定路径.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Dataset and Tasks. We evaluate GDGraph on 347 text-based radiology cases curated from PMC-Patients-V2 [ 18 ] and PubMed Central case reports across three clinical guidelines (Table 1 ). Cases were screened for guideline-relevant imaging findings and clinical context. Reference labels were taken from explicit source labels or derived by applying guideline criteria to the reported findings. Case descriptions were reformulated using GPT-6.1-sol to remove explicit diagnostic labels and reduce the risk of answer leakage. CUA evaluates management selection given the clinical context, whereas O-RADS and K-TIRADS assign ultrasound risk categories from imaging descriptions.
blocks.zh: 数据集与任务. 我们从PMC-Patients-V2[18]和PubMed Central病例报告中,对347个基于文字的放射病例进行了GDGraph评估(表1)。 对病例进行了检测,以了解相关成像结果和临床背景。 参考标签取自明确的来源标签,或通过对报告的调查结果适用准则标准得出。 案件描述被重新拟订,使用GPT-6.1-溶液去除明显的诊断标签,并减少答案漏漏的风险。 CUA根据临床背景评价管理选择,而O-RADS和K-TIRADS则从成像描述中指定超声波风险类别。

blocks.zh: 表1:评估临床指南、目标任务和病例统计摘要。

blocks.en: Implementation and Baselines. Decision graphs are constructed offline using GPT-6-Luna with low reasoning effort, processing extracted text alongside PDF page images to preserve table structures and footnotes. For online evaluation, we use the System One model Jev (v1.13.0) [ 1 ] and GPT-4o across six settings: (1) baselines without retrieval or GDGraph ( Direct Jev , Direct GPT-4o , and GPT-4o CoT ), which receive only the clinical case, candidate options, and option definitions; (2) retrieval-augmented generation ( RAG+GPT-4o CoT ), where GPT-4o generates three search queries per case and MedCPT [ 7 ] retrieves the top- K K ( K = 5 K=5 ) guideline chunks per query for CoT reasoning; and (3) graph-guided inference ( GDGraph+Jev and GDGraph+GPT-4o CoT ), which traverse the same constructed GDGraph for each task.
blocks.zh: 执行和基线。 决定图是使用GPT-6-Luna线下构造的,推理能力低,与PDF页面图像一起处理提取的文本,以保存表格结构和脚注. 为了在线评价,我们使用系统一模型Jev(v1.13.0)[1]和GPT-4o在6个设置:(1)没有检索的基线或GDGraph(Direct Jev,Direct GPT-4o,和GPT-4o CoT),只接收临床病例,候选选项和选项定义;(2)检索-增强生成(RAG+GPT-4o CoT),其中GPT-4o每个案例生成3个搜索查询,MedCPT[7]为CoT推理每次查询获取顶端-K(K=5K=5)指令块;以及(3)图导推论(GDGraph+Jev和GDGPT-4o CoT),每个任务都转录同一构造的GDGGraph.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. For graph quality (Table 2 ), we manually verify node precision (proportion of atomic conditions with source-supported questions and definitions) and rule precision (proportion of extracted transition rules supported by the source guideline). For decision performance and efficiency, we report case accuracy (Acc.), weighted F1 (WF1), and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) [ 9 ] , alongside mean online API time and cost per case.
blocks.zh: 评价计量。 关于图表质量(表2),我们手动核查节点精度(原子条件与来源支持的问题和定义的比例)和规则精度(来源指南支持提取过渡规则的比例). 关于决定的绩效和效率,我们报告案件准确性(Acc),加权F1(WF1)和Matthews相关系数[9],同时报告每个案件的平均在线API时间和费用。

blocks.en: Table 2: Precision of constructed decision graphs against source guidelines, reported as supported/total (%).
blocks.zh: 表2:对照源指南对构建的决定图表的精确度,报告为支持/总计(%)。

blocks.en: Table 3: Comparison of decision performance across 347 radiology cases. Acc.: case accuracy; WF1: weighted F1-score; MCC: Matthews correlation coefficient. Best results within each task are shown in bold.
blocks.zh: 表3:347个放射病例的决策业绩比较。 Acc:大小写精度;WF1:加权F1-分数;MCC:Matthews相关系数. 每项任务的最佳成果用黑体表示。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Comparison of online inference efficiency across the three guideline tasks, measured by (a) mean cumulative API time (s/case) and (b) mean API cost ( 10 − 3 10^{-3} USD/case).
blocks.zh: 图 2: 三个准则任务的在线推论效率比较,衡量标准是:(a) 累计API时间(s/case)和(b) 平均API费用(10-3 10^{-3}美元/case)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Graph Fidelity and Comparison with Retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.2 图解和检索比较

blocks.en: In the source-based review (Table 2 ), the constructed graphs achieve 99.8% overall node precision and 96.4% rule precision, showing high source fidelity. On downstream tasks (Table 3 ), unguided Direct GPT-4o and GPT-4o CoT fall below 60% accuracy on CUA and K-TIRADS. Unstructured retrieval ( RAG+GPT-4o CoT ) raises overall GPT-4o CoT accuracy from 51.9% to 80.1%, while graph guidance ( GDGraph+GPT-4o CoT ) reaches 82.7%. While RAG performs better on O-RADS (84.6% vs. 78.6%), graph guidance excels on K-TIRADS (79.6% vs. 67.0%), where stratification jointly depends on nodule composition, echogenicity, and suspicious features, showing that explicit paths with linked definitions help resolve multi-feature criteria.
blocks.zh: 在基于源的审查(表2)中,构建的图表实现了99.8%的总节点精度和96.4%的规则精度,显示出高源忠诚度. 在下游任务(表3)中,无制导的Direct GPT-4o和GPT-4o CoT在CUA和K-TIRADS上的精度低于60%. 非结构检索(RAG+GPT-4o CoT)将总的GPT-4o CoT精度从51.9%提高到80.1%,而图导(GDGraph+GPT-4o CoT)则达到82.7%。 虽然RAG在O-RADS(84.6%对78.6%)上表现较好,但图导在K-TIRADS(79.6%对67.0%)上表现优异,其中的分层共同依赖于结核的成分、回声率和可疑特征,表明带有相关定义的明确路径有助于解决多种特性标准。

blocks.en: 3.3 System One Performance and Inference Efficiency
blocks.zh: 3.3 系统一性能和推论效率

blocks.en: We next evaluate whether pairing GDGraph with the System One model Jev improves decision accuracy (Table 3 ) and compare its online inference efficiency against the GPT-4o baselines (Fig. 3 ). Given only the case content, the candidate options, and their definitions ( Direct Jev ), Jev reaches 57.3% overall accuracy (35.0% on K-TIRADS). When the same cases are evaluated using GDGraph ( GDGraph+Jev ), performance improves across all three tasks, reaching 90.8% overall accuracy and achieving the highest Acc., WF1, and MCC in each guideline. Additionally, GDGraph+Jev achieves higher accuracy than both GDGraph+GPT-4o CoT (82.7%) and RAG+GPT-4o CoT (80.1%), while requiring 0.79–1.62 s per case in online API time (vs. 6.16–7.15 s for RAG+GPT-4o CoT and 17.10–34.97 s for GDGraph+GPT-4o CoT ) and 0.56 0.56 – 1.07 × 10 − 3 1.07\times 10^{-3} USD per case in API cost (Fig. 3 ). These results indicate that organizing guidelines into localized node judgments and explicit rules enables the System One model to resolve multi-condition criteria with low online inference latency and cost.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来评价GDGraph与System One模型Jev是否提高了决策准确性(表3),并将其在线推论效率与GPT-4o基线(图3)进行比较。 仅考虑到案例内容,候选选项及其定义(Direct Jev),Jev达到57.3%的整体准确度(K-TIRADS为35.0%). 在使用GDGraph(GDGraph+Jev)评估相同案例时,所有三项任务的业绩都有所改善,总体准确度达到90.8%,并在每项准则中达到最高的Acc.,WF1和MCC. 此外,GDGraph+Jev的精度高于GDGraph+GPT-4o CoT(82.7%)和RAG+GPT-4o CoT(80.1%),而在线API时间要求每例0.79–1.62 s (RAG+GPT-4o CoT为6.16–7.15 s,GDGGGraph+GPT-4o CoT为17.10–34.97 s)和0.56 0.56–1.07 ×10–1.07\tims 10^{-3} API成本为每例美元(图3)。 这些结果表明,将准则组织成局部节点判断和明确规则,使系统一号模型能够以低在线推论延迟性和成本解决多条件标准。

blocks.en: 3.4 Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4 错误分析

blocks.en: Among the remaining errors, we identify two recurring patterns that highlight the main limitations of GDGraph-guided inference. In 11 K-TIRADS cases, “ill-defined margins” or “irregular shape” were interpreted as “irregular margins,” activating a higher-risk branch because node definitions did not explicitly contrast these terms. In three O-RADS cases, errors arose when mapping qualitative vascularity descriptions (e.g., moderate flow) to node-level criteria. These observations highlight the importance of normalizing radiological descriptions and aligning imaging concepts with model representations across varied reports.
blocks.zh: 在剩余的错误中,我们发现了两个反复出现的模式,这些模式突出了GDGraph指导推论的主要局限性。 在11个K-TIRADS案件中,“非固定边距”或“非正常形状”被解释为“非正常边距”,激活了风险较高的分支,因为节点定义没有明确地与这些术语形成对照。 在三个O-RADS案例中,在将定性血管描述(如中度流量)映射到节点级标准时出现错误. 这些观测结果突出表明,必须使放射描述正常化,并使成像概念与不同报告的模型表述保持一致。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We proposed GDGraph, a framework that converts radiology guidelines into executable decision graphs for risk stratification and management planning. During compilation, an LLM constructs the graph through section-based chunking, local subgraph extraction, and cross-branch aggregation. During inference, the System One model answers localized questions along the graph, yielding a traceable decision path. Experiments on three guidelines show that GDGraph+Jev achieves higher accuracy than CoT-based GPT-4o baselines at lower latency and cost, indicating its practical value for auditable clinical decision support.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了GDGraph,这个框架将放射学准则转化为风险分层和管理规划的可执行决定图表。 在编译过程中,一个LLM通过基于分区的块,本地子图提取,以及跨分支聚合来构建图. 在推论期间,System One模型沿着图解解局部问题,得出可追踪的决定路径. 三条准则的实验表明,GDGraph+Jev以更低的延迟性和成本达到比基于CoT的GPT-4o基线更高的精度,表明其对可审计临床决策支持的实际价值.
